text:
Mira Patel: Quick sync — Redpoint onprem activation tomorrow 09:00 PT. Short checklist: network firewall rules, registry mirroring, GPG key rotation, CR approvals. Who's owning each?
Cho Ivers: I'll own firewall rules + PR to netops. CR: CR-8472 for egress NAT, CR-8473 for firewall ports.
Dan Romero: I'll take registry mirror + image push. Mirror job is already staged, needs final creds and GPG key.
Jess Nguyen: Certs and image signing owner from security side. Will validate GPG and rotation window.
Mira Patel: thanks. Dan — can you sanity check the ports we need allowed? Staging showed CI->registry via proxy on 443 outbound only.
Dan Romero: ports we need: 443 outbound to mirror endpoint, 22 tcp from our jumpbox for rsync (can be ephemeral). Also ephemeral high ports for kube image pulls.
Cho Ivers: netops please open: 443 out to 35.201.12.0/24 (mirror), 10.8.0.0/16 for internal jumpbox. I'll file the patch now.
infra-bot: Preflight result: 6/7 checks passed. registry-reachability: failed to TLS handshake with mirror endpoint (timeout). See logs: ```curl -v https://mirror.redpoint.example.com/health```
Mira Patel: @Dan can you run a quick curl from the staging bastion and paste output?
Dan Romero: ran from bastion, got timeout. Suspect NAT rule not attached to the bastion subnet. CLI quick check: ```gcloud compute routers get-status router-redpoint --region us-west1```
Cho Ivers: ack — looks like the Cloud NAT association missed the bastion subnetwork in the CR. Updating CR-8472 now.
Jess Nguyen: FYI security wants the GPG key rotation done in a short window tomorrow 08:30-08:45 PT. Dan — prepare signed manifest and include the signature in the mirror tarball.
Dan Romero: will do. Example signing command I'll use: ```gpg --batch --yes --local-user 0xA1B2C3D4 --output manifest.sig --detach-sign manifest.json```
Mira Patel: plan for rollback? If mirror fails we fallback to hosted model in us-east with 95ms penalty. Need owners for the rollback switch.
Cho Ivers: I'll own rollback traffic routing (route table change). Jess — you'll coordinate the secret swap?
Jess Nguyen: yes. I'll stage new secret versions in vault and pin them in the private control plane config.
Mira Patel: action items condensed: 1) Cho — update CR-8472 & get netops approval, 2) Dan — run mirror health + push signed manifest, 3) Jess — GPG rotation + secrets, 4) Mira — coordinate cutover and monitor.
Dan Romero: pinging @netops alias now for ETA on NAT association.
NetOps: ETA ~45m for NAT assoc, will confirm in thread when done. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: Updated preflight: registry-reachability: pass (TLS OK). image-signature: pending.
Jess Nguyen: signature verified locally. I'll upload manifest.sig to the mirror location after Dan pushes artifacts.
Mira Patel: perfect. Final smoke at 08:55 PT? If all green we'll flip at 09:00 PT.
Cho Ivers: noted. I'll send the route change CR at 08:58 and tag @oncall.
Mira Patel: thanks everyone. If anything critical pops, escalate in #incidents. :shipit:
